main_topics.reason: The user repeatedly asked whether the reduction in migraine days meant Emgality was working and whether it might improve further.
The user expressed disappointment and worry about the response, then said the discussion made them feel better and reframed their view.
The user described logging migraine days in an app and discussed tracking severity as well as frequency.
The user reported that their migraines had become less severe and recognised this as an improvement.
The user asked what to raise with their neurologist and worried the clinician might stop the treatment.

output.summary: The user asked whether a decrease from about 20 to 15 migraine days per month after three months on Emgality counted as improvement, and later noted the attacks were also less severe. The assistant framed the response as partial improvement, suggested continuing tracking and discussing reassessment around six months with the neurologist; the user said they felt better and that the conversation had genuinely reframed their view.
